title: The Crab Derby, 2004
logline: Twentieth annual. Two crabs, a cup — and the flyer is drawn on the tablet for the first time. It looks wrong. Gully says so.

panels.composition: Gully's. WOOD with a printed flyer — drawn digitally, the crab's hatching replaced by a gray fill. GULLY holding it at arm's length. BARNABY.
props: a printed flyer with flat gray fills

balloons.text: He's digital. Twenty years, I thought—

image.prompt: a stocky man in an apron holding a printed flyer at arm's length with a skeptical face, the crab on it filled with flat gray instead of hatching, a thin man beside him, a dog, muddy digital flats

panels.composition: The printed crab. Flat. The nine hand-drawn ones on the wall behind it, alive.
props: nine hatched crabs on the wall

image.prompt: close-up of a flat gray digital crab on a printout held up in front of a wall of nine richly hatched hand-drawn crab flyers

panels.composition: Wood taking the flyer back. Getting a pen from Gully's register cup. Hatching over the print by hand on the counter.

characters.pose: hatching over the printout by hand

image.prompt: a thin man hatching by hand over a printed flyer on a shop counter with a pen from the register cup, no words

panels.composition: The tenth flyer on the wall: printed, then hatched over. A hybrid. Gully pins it. Says nothing. The strip's position on the new tools, in one flyer.

image.prompt: ten crab flyers in a row on a shingle wall, the newest a printout hatched over by hand, a man in an apron pinning it, muddy flats

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy digital flats; Sundays in watercolor, improving
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays gray-green, rust, one warm

notes: The digital crab, corrected by hand. The strip's stance on 2004.
